pageDescription: Review your sign-ins and manage access to your account.
manageAccountDescription: Manage passwords, two-step verification and connected accounts in your browser. Check the account shown there before making changes.
activeSessionsDescription: Your browser and Nimi Home can have separate sign-ins on the same computer. Each row represents a login session.
revokeCurrent: Sign out of this Home session
currentConsequence: This Home session will end. Sign in again to continue using your account.
oneConsequence: Sign out the session created {{time}}? The app using it will need to sign in again.
othersConsequence: Only this Home session will stay signed in. This also signs out browsers on this computer and apps on other devices.
revoked: The selected login sessions have been signed out.
localExitPending: The server ended this session. Sign out in Home again to complete local sign-out.
accountChanged: The current account changed. Review its login sessions again.
readFailed: Could not load the latest sign-ins. Try refreshing.
revokeUnconfirmed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Refresh the list to check its status.
